methods.label: Find the effective coverage rate
methods.explanation:
For this estimate, neglect turning time and small effects at the edges of the lawn. The overlapping part of a swath cuts grass that has already been cut, so the effective width for new coverage is
\[
28-4=24\text{ inches}=2\text{ feet}.
\]
Each foot of forward travel therefore covers about \(2\) square feet of new lawn. At \(5000\) feet per hour, Moe covers about \(2\cdot5000=10000\) square feet per hour.

The lawn has area \(90\cdot150=13500\) square feet, so the estimated mowing time is
\[
\frac{13500}{10000}=1.35\text{ hours}.
\]
The closest choice is \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
